summary.text: Anne Brensley is the Republican nominee for Secretary of the Commonwealth. An attorney and business executive, she is a former Wayland Select Board member and is campaigning on business growth, voter engagement and ballot integrity, including Portuguese-language ballots.

paragraphs.text: Attorney and business executive; her campaign describes her as CEO of DevCo North America with more than 100 real estate transactions.

Former member of the Wayland Select Board; adopted from Honduras as a child, and described by the Fall River Reporter as the first Latina nominated for statewide office by a major party in Massachusetts.
